d: At the 'Samvidhan Raksha' march, Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge said, 'The Congress party is never going to die. We have a history spanning 143 years; if the Congress party hasn’t perished in 143 years, why would it die now? We now have a leader who fears no one, and whom no one can intimidate. As for us, we are not the kind of people who live in fear. Others, out of fear, might join the BJP or stay home. But we—who helped create this Constitution—will protect it; we will not be afraid of anyone. The RSS was opposed to this Constitution—everyone knows this, and they still are. They…
